summary: Root-cause fix for the backward regression. Setting imitation=0 for reverse commands and widening the overspeed band restores a real reverse gait in native MuJoCo: v15 reaches -0.072 / -0.095 m/s, versus -0.004 / -0.006 m/s for v13/v14. It still falls after 1.8-2.5 s, which is the original v12 instability and the open problem.

command_quantisation_mapped_low_speed_re.measurement: Reference grid is dx in {-0.148, -0.074, 0.0, +0.074, +0.148, +0.222}. A -0.03 command resolves to dx=0.000, i.e. the standing reference: max|low_cmd_ref - standing_ref| = 0.0000.
command_quantisation_mapped_low_speed_re.correction: An earlier version of this file claimed the dataset has no reverse gait because -0.03 and +0.03 gave the same reference norm. That was wrong: both simply round to the +-0.074 mirror pair, which are similar in norm by gait symmetry. The entries at -0.074 and +0.074 are genuinely different gaits (max abs coefficient difference 8471).
command_quantisation_mapped_low_speed_re.effect: With imitation=0.25 the v13/v15 curriculum (-0.025..-0.035, all landing on dx=0) actively pinned the policy to standing. Zeroing imitation removed that standing anchor -- which is why v15 produced motion, not because reverse references are missing.
command_quantisation_mapped_low_speed_re.fix: imitation defaults to 0 for backward, and is exposed as BACKWARD_IMITATION so a run targeting the -0.074 grid value can restore the balance prior.

overspeed_band_narrower_than_gait_oscill.measurement: At a -0.04 m/s command the old allowance was 1.10*0.04+0.005 = 0.049 m/s, below the normal velocity oscillation of a walking gait, so overspeed cost ~= 4000 * overspeed * dt ~= -8 per step while progress was worth about +2.5. Standing still scored strictly better.
overspeed_band_narrower_than_gait_oscill.effect: Every run from v12 to v14 converged to the near-stationary optimum.
overspeed_band_narrower_than_gait_oscill.fix: allowance is max(1.5 * command, 0.15) and the weight is 600 instead of 4000.

before.verdict: moving only marginally better; noise dominates

next: v16 keeps the corrected incentive and re-raises the posture costs (tilt/height margins and termination) to add stability, since the direction of the reward is no longer the blocker.

v16_result.config: v15 checkpoint, re-raised posture/termination costs via BACKWARD_TILT_MARGIN etc.
v16_result.conclusion: Raising posture costs alone does not fix the fall: with imitation off the policy has no gait prior and lunges until it tips.

v17_plan: Target the reference grid value -0.074 (curriculum -0.06..-0.09) and restore imitation (0.5 vs 1.0), so the policy gets both a real reverse gait prior and the balance it provides.
